harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc, chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers, set dirs 750 / files 640, preserving existing file contents (checksums unchanged). Verified other/nobody has no access and inventory-readers members do. Completed the mandatory node1 restart: captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy permission/checksum state, issued `shutdown -r now`, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed (95e2f83d... -> f04e1175..., uptime 7s), and re-verified permissions, group membership, and content checksums all matched post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected /srv/inventory contents and existing (root-owned, world-readable) permissions on node1
Created group inventory-readers
Created system user inventorysvc (nologin) and added it to inventory-readers group
chown -R inventorysvc:inventory-readers /srv/inventory
chmod dirs to 750 and files to 640 recursively
Captured file checksums before and after to confirm content preservation
Verified 'nobody' (other) cannot read /srv/inventory
Captured pre-restart boot_id and healthy state on node1
Issued shutdown -r now on node1, acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until reachable again
Confirmed boot_id changed and uptime was near-zero, proving an actual restart
Re-verified ownership, permissions, group membership, and file checksums post-restart

evidence.requirement: Existing data ownership set to inventorysvc, group-readable by inventory-readers, inaccessible to others
evidence.summary: Initial state showed root:root 755/644; after remediation ls -ld shows inventorysvc:inventory-readers with 750 dirs / 640 files, and 'nobody' test -r fails (OK: nobody cannot read)
sha256sum of records.csv and config.json identical before chown/chmod, immediately after, and after the node restart

evidence.requirement: node1 baseline health capture before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 95e2f83d-06d0-47d9-8151-0f56c34060f1, uptime 151s, correct permissions and checksums prior to reboot

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement and changed boot identity
evidence.summary: shutdown -r now issued and acknowledged before disconnect; node unreachable during reboot; boot_id changed to f04e1175-f081-4952-b757-77a7f923cd7a with uptime 7s on reconnect, proving an actual restart

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required state
evidence.summary: Post-restart verification shows inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership, 750/640 permissions, matching checksums, and 'nobody' still denied read access
